title: RossFast D3R 36-material production envelope
purpose: Expand only the admitted RossFast D3R Staringreeks material catalog from the six F-ROSS12 materials to the full 36-material unimodal Mualem-van Genuchten KSATFIT catalog while preserving the existing solver, geometry, transaction, retry, commit and production routing contracts.

reused_scientific_evidence.constitutive_scope: Staringreeks 2018 unimodal MvG using KSATFIT with KSATEXM disabled; homogeneous unsaturated 10-cm faces; h=[-10000,-1] cm

required_before_admission: Materialize immutable N241 production table assets for the remaining 30 catalog materials from the pinned qualified research authority.
Extend the production material catalog and provider mapping without changing constitutive equations or table representation.
Qualify every added asset against independently regenerated pinned-research oracle data.
Qualify O0/O2 identity and the existing D3R solver route for all 36 materials inside the unchanged F-ROSS12 execution envelope.
Re-run fail-closed checks for unknown material, missing/corrupt/mismatched asset and parameter drift.
Re-run relevant production selection and serialized-host regression evidence proving Reference behavior unchanged and no RossFast fallback.
next_permitted_action: Recover the exact current production table-provider implementation and F-ROSS04 asset-generation/qualification path, then materialize and qualify the remaining 30 assets before widening production admission.
